start: ^We playtested consistently to ensure the build was stable and fun before release.
^Want to hear how we ran our testing?
technical_detail: ^We set up and monitored our internal closed testing tracks via the Play Console for remote testers, while simultaneously organizing in-person playtesting sessions at different venues.
^Our analytics pipeline helped out a lot here, because we could see how much time spent in the game was being used to learn.
^We used this data to iteratively refine our design, improving our game!
